title: Rig Relay
description: Rig Relay is a governed local agent platform — evidence-backed, receipt-governed, inspectable.
tagline: Governed local runtime for agent work.
plain_language_summary: AI agents can change code faster than people can inspect what happened. Rig Relay makes agent work observable, controlled, and reviewable.
partner_friendly_explanation: Rig Relay is like a controlled workstation for AI agents. Instead of letting agents mutate code invisibly, it gives the work a station, a mirror, a checklist, and receipts.

what_works_today: Local desktop bridge launches and serves the cockpit UI
Frontend connects via WebSocket and receives live projections
Static evidence site is live on GitHub Pages
220+ canonical JSON documentation pages rendered to HTML
Code schemas define implementation contracts with authority hashes
Security threat model v0 with 17 threats and 5 release gates
WebSocket hardened with origin validation, message schema checks, and auth gating
Deterministic code schema router selects contracts before agents edit code
Static diagrams render from JSON specs (flow, state machine, timeline, matrix)

feature_cards.title: Governed Execution
feature_cards.description: Agent tools are permission-gated. Destructive operations require approval. Stale batch reuse is prevented.

feature_cards.title: Correlated Tracing
feature_cards.description: Trace events carry correlation IDs and handshake IDs. Content-light doctrine keeps secrets out of traces.

feature_cards.title: Evidence Receipts
feature_cards.description: Every agent action produces verifiable receipts. Reports are append-only JSONL. Ralph scans for regressions.

feature_cards.title: Code Schemas
feature_cards.description: Implementation contracts encoded as JSON. Authority hashes prevent tampering. Context assembler routes tasks to schemas.

feature_cards.title: Static Evidence Site
feature_cards.description: All documentation is canonical JSON rendered to static HTML. No backend, no database, no tracking.

feature_cards.title: Security-Aware Bridge
feature_cards.description: Desktop bridge validates WebSocket origins and messages. Auth-before-subscribe. Invalid message guard closes abusive connections.
